workflow_binding: none; existing authorized workflows invoke the generic capability
trigger_contract: A repository-controlled v2 manifest explicitly authorizes production publication, binds every artifact by Git blob SHA-1, includes the exact machine-proof bundle in the upload fileset and proves candidate-specific prepublication return to Ingolf Lohmann.

genericity.artifact_identity: repository path plus exact Git blob SHA-1

verification: exact v2 bundle/return license, publication-ID and RFC3339 instance semantics
execution-head binding for active and byte-frozen legacy contract files
platform/repository attestation boundary without biometric claim
atomic create-only repository-remote Git consumption ref
credential token leak rejection across metadata, proof, authorization and upload bytes
proof bundle inclusion in Zenodo fileset
artifact MD5 and SHA-256 before upload
recovery: Existing publication evidence or the create-only/non-force repository-remote authorization-consumption ref blocks duplicate mutation for cooperating publishers. Privileged ref deletion or force-update remains an external repository-ruleset boundary. Interrupted runs leave no DONE claim and require explicit remote-state reconciliation before retry.
rollback: No destructive rollback of a published DOI. Corrections require a new version with preserved history and a new prepublication return receipt.
effect_boundary: A workflow result is not publication evidence until the proof-bearing evidence JSON is committed and the public record has passed the client's independent public GET and byte-redownload gates.
license: Implementation files declare their own software license; non-software policy artifacts are CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0
